svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Recall by distance from the fact
svg.desc: How fast does recall fall as the fact recedes, for each arm and salience?
svg.text: Recall by distance from the fact
Buckets nearest first; scored probes only (undelivered and failed turns are counted apart, never as misses).
